about: Wikidata classes the pipeline collects from (instances via wdt:P31/wdt:P279*), each with the archive project_type it maps to (site-public-cleared/archive-taxonomy.js keys) and its include/exclude rule.
"verified": true only when a web search restricted to wikidata.org returned a result whose URL is exactly this item with this label (verified_by); otherwise "verified": false with the reason.

Every run writes the live label, description and instance counts of every class to review/classes.json. A class is PUBLISHED FROM only when it is verified, included, and its live label still matches; every other class is queried for discovery counts only, never published from, until a human marks it verified.

Blocklist classes only remove items (an item whose own P31 is one of them). An entry is applied when it is verified, or when this run's live label of the QID equals the configured label (logged in review/classes.json).
When several classes give different types, a class that is the item's own P31 wins; otherwise the most specific type (lib/entities.mjs TYPE_PRIORITY).
verified_method: WebSearch with allowed_domains ["wikidata.org"], one query per QID ("<label> <QID>"); verified_by is the result URL that showed the item.

classes.label: media facade
classes.rule: Instances are media facades. The live discovery of 2026-10-19 found 0 instances: real media facades are buildings without this class, which is why the Wikipedia media-facade discovery exists (config/pipeline.json "wikipedia").

classes.label: mediafacade
classes.rule: Instances are media facades (ruwiki "Медиафасад"). The class itself is an instance of out-of-home advertising, so an instance that is only a billboard is removed by the billboard blocklist entries.

classes.label: projection mapping
classes.rule: Works and shows that are instances of projection mapping (1 instance with coordinates on 2026-10-19). Commons "Category:Projection mapping" is walked as well (config/categories.json).

classes.label: light art
classes.rule: Instances of light art and of its subclasses (14 instances, 8 with coordinates on 2026-10-19). Its subclass "drone display" is removed by the blocklist.

classes.label: light installation
classes.rule: The largest light class: 138 instances, 94 with coordinates on 2026-10-19 (e.g. Field of Light Q5447104, The Bay Lights Q7715933, Urban Light Q7899954).

classes.label: light sculpture
classes.rule: Light sculptures with a location (26 instances, 9 with coordinates on 2026-10-19).

classes.label: LED art
classes.rule: A subclass of light art (already reached through light art); listed for its own discovery count and type. Instance count unknown until the first live run.

classes.label: lights festival
classes.rule: Light festivals (23 instances, 3 with coordinates on 2026-10-19; e.g. Fête des Lumières Q4167, Jerusalem Festival of Light Q4173984). Religious festivals of lights carry no city or coordinates and fail eligibility.

classes.label: new media arts festival
classes.rule: Media art festivals with a host city (e.g. FILE Q5358269).

classes.label: digital arts festival
classes.rule: Digital art festivals with a host city (a near-duplicate of Q126682969 on Wikidata; both are queried).

classes.label: son et lumière
classes.rule: Sound and light shows on buildings and monuments. A subclass of light art; a direct instance is typed as a show (festival_program).

classes.label: immersive art exhibit
classes.rule: Immersive media art spaces with a location (5 instances, 1 with coordinates on 2026-10-19).

classes.label: multimedia immersive exhibition
classes.rule: Immersive exhibitions; many are touring shows, so only instances with coordinates are kept.

classes.label: interactive artwork
classes.rule: Interactive artworks with coordinates (public interactive installations). The genre item "interactive art" (Q2394336) is not a class: Wikidata asks for this item as the P31 value.

classes.label: video wall
classes.rule: Video walls with a location (e.g. IAC Video Wall Q17028586): LED or media walls on architecture. Only located instances are kept, listed as low-confidence types until an editor confirms them; advertising screens are removed by the billboard blocklist entries. Verified 2026-10-20 (search result URL = this item, label "video wall"); instance count unknown until the first live run.

classes.label: new media art
classes.rule: Broad: 265 instances but only 4 with coordinates on 2026-10-19. Only instances with coordinates are kept, typed "other" and listed as low-confidence types in quality.json until an editor sets a type.

classes.label: digital art
classes.rule: Discovery only: a subclass of new media art, mostly screen-based works without a site.

classes.label: video installation
classes.rule: Discovery only: gallery video installations rarely have a public site; enable after reviewing review/classes.json.

classes.label: installation artwork
classes.rule: Discovery only: far too broad (every installation artwork). Light installations enter through Q1823448.

classes.label: laser lighting show
classes.rule: Discovery only: mostly concert and venue effects, not architecture.

classes.label: musical fountain
classes.rule: Discovery only: water and light shows (e.g. Sentosa Musical Fountain Q7451371). An operator may include it after reviewing the counts.

classes.label: media artwork
classes.unverified_reason: No search result showed this item page itself (only a talk page mentioning it).
classes.rule: Excluded: 26,875 instances on 2026-10-19 (30 with coordinates), mostly films, series and media files.

classes.label: illuminated building
classes.unverified_reason: No search result showed this item.
classes.rule: Discovery only: 0 instances on 2026-10-19 ("state where a building is illuminated"). Architectural lighting enters only through the specific classes above; Commons "Illuminated buildings" categories are image evidence only (config/categories.json).

blocklist.label: digital billboard
blocklist.unverified_reason: The search result URL was its redirect Q11812165, not this item.

blocklist.label: drone display
blocklist.reason: a show in the sky, not architecture; a subclass of light art, so its instances would otherwise enter through light art

blocklist.label: Wikimedia disambiguation page
blocklist.unverified_reason: Only the talk page appeared in the search results.

blocklist.label: Light show
blocklist.reason: a disambiguation page ("Category:Light shows" links to it)

blocklist.label: human
blocklist.unverified_reason: Only the talk page appeared in the search results.
blocklist.reason: a person; also caught by the "human" class-label rule

blocklist.label: Wikimedia category
blocklist.reason: a category item: the pipeline follows its P301 main topic instead; one without a main topic is removed

properties.about: Every property the pipeline reads. The discovery step fetches their live labels into review/properties.json; a property whose live label does not contain the expected text is not used in that run (reported in report.json).
properties.P131: located in the administrative territorial entity
